compute_metric_results: compute evaluation metrics by adding predictions and references then calling compute on a metric module

combine_multiple_metrics: combine multiple evaluation modules into a single CombinedEvaluations object for batch computation

review_combined_evaluations: review the CombinedEvaluations class and its merge logic for handling duplicate result keys
